description: Call this when the user asks what Hyperliquid whales are doing, whether the biggest Hyperliquid accounts are net long or short a coin, for the largest open positions with liquidation prices, or what large accounts just opened, closed or flipped. Returns the live board of the 300 largest accounts by equity (scanned every 5 minutes, addresses only) and with events the last 200 position changes.
